title: Mitosis and Cell Division
summary: Mitosis divides one cell into two genetically identical daughter cells.

key_concepts.explanation: A tightly packed structure of DNA.
The protein fibres that pull chromosomes apart.

outline.heading: Phases of mitosis
points: Metaphase lines them up in the middle.

outline.heading: Cytokinesis
points: The cell membrane pinches in two.
Each daughter cell gets one full set of chromosomes.
